thread:
maria: Quick heads-up — seeing a surge of 5xxs from east-1 dedicated pool since ~08:12. Latency spikes then tail drops. I want to temporarily route new sessions with header `x-ingress-affinity: fallback` to the fallback GPU pool so we can drain the primary while we triage.
kevin: Can we do a scoped header override? I want to avoid global route flips. Prefer a per-route match: `match: path_prefix /v1/` + header insert. How fast is telemetry for this change? :thinking:
jamal: We have an emergency toggle API: `POST /internal/admin/routing/override` with body `{ "match": {"path_prefix": "/v1/","header": "x-ingress-affinity"}, "set": {"x-ingress-affinity": "fallback"}, "ttl_s": 3600 }` — but it's atomic per-router and will land across edge in ~6–12s. Use `dry_run=true` first if you want to preview.
sophie: Console rollout UX question — if you use the API we should also create a rollback button. Right now console doesn't auto-surface temporary overrides created via the admin API. Could we attach a `meta: {"created_by": "maria", "incident": "INC-1124"}` field so ops can see it in the overrides list?
maria: Yes please add meta. Jamal, do the admin API accept `meta`? I can wait 2m for a safer flow.
jamal: It accepts `meta` but the UI won't show it until we push a small index change. I'll patch the console index — should be 2–3 min. Deploy-bot: deploy queued for branch `console/override-index-fix` by jamal.
deploy-bot: CI passed · starting canary rollout
kevin: For rollback plan: 1) unset header override (POST with empty `set` or `delete_keys`), 2) revert any config changes to route weights, 3) confirm 200/latency stable in telemetry for 10m. If step 1 fails, we have to flip the region-level fallback route pin.
maria: I'll wait for the console patch, then do `dry_run=true` to validate. If dry_run looks good, I'll run with `ttl_s=1800` and set a calendar reminder to re-evaluate at +25m. Add @oncall FYI.
sophie: Filed a quick console issue: RED-UI-322, links to admin API and incident metadata. UI patch is on canary.
jamal: Patch done. Console index updated. You should see overrides in Console > Routing > Active overrides within ~15s.
maria: Doing dry_run now. Curl snippet:
```
curl -X POST "https://internal.redwood/api/admin/routing/override?dry_run=true" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"match":{"path_prefix":"/v1/","method":"POST"},"set":{"x-ingress-affinity":"fallback"},"ttl_s":1800,"meta":{"created_by":"maria","incident":"INC-1124"}}'
```
kevin: Dry-run logs look good in the preview — it shows the match hits and target group counts. Telemetry sim shows ~98% routed to fallback in simulation. :thumbsup:
maria: Ok executing live now without dry_run. Will monitor latency and 5xxs. If anything weird within 60s I will unset.
deploy-bot: override applied to router pool `ingress-east-1` (id: rtr-4432) by maria — propagation ~8s
jamal: Telemetry: backend_errors down 70% in the affected corridor. Latency smoothing still a bit high, but trending down. Keep watching.
maria: Seeing 503 down to near baseline. Good. Leaving TTL 30m. Reminder set for +25m.
kevin: Postmortem notes: consider an automatic rollback trigger if error rate falls <5% or spike persists >15m. Also add a toggle in console for auto-revert on success criteria.
sophie: I'll add a quick UX card for auto-revert (RED-UX-88). Keep me in the loop for copy and the success criteria.
maria: Thanks all. Adding final note to the incident thread. If we need to fully evacuate, plan is: 1) set ingress pin to fallback cluster, 2) scale up fallback pool, 3) disable cache warming paths. For now, containment looks good. Closing this routing shim thread.
